run_image_classification_pipeline: run the ImageClassificationPipeline with a PIL image to get top 5 predicted class labels and scores
load_model_config_from_hf: load a MindSpore model and its config from a HuggingFace model ID using snapshot_download
load_transform_func: load a dataset transform function like mnist or cifar10 from a config dictionary
load_config_json: load and parse a JSON configuration file and return the resulting dictionary
review_allowed_models: review the ALLOWED_MODEL dictionary mapping LeNet5, ResNet50, and MobileNetV2 to their model constructors
